parsed.name: KA系列可编程直流电源
parsed.name_en: KA Series Programmable DC Bench Power Supply
parsed.description: KA系列台式可编程直流稳压电源，可设定输出电压与电流限值，并测量输出电压、电流和功率，常用于电子电路供电、器件测试、实验教学以及台式研发调试。
parsed.description_en: A KA-series programmable bench DC power supply used to provide regulated DC power with configurable voltage and current limit, and to measure output voltage, current, and power. It is commonly used for circuit powering, device testing, teaching labs, and bench-top R&D troubleshooting.

actions.description: 初始化电源并准备受控使用。
actions.description_en: Initialize the power supply for controlled operation.

actions.description: 设置命令/面板锁定状态；该机型在USB连接时通常会自动锁定前面板。
actions.description_en: Set the command/front-panel lock state; this model typically auto-locks the front panel when connected over USB.

actions.description: 设置远端感测状态；该机型通常不支持远端感测。
actions.description_en: Set the remote-sense state; this model typically does not support remote sensing.
Turn the power output on or off.
